description: Isaac Newton Group of Telescopes (La Palma) filter database: throughput scans of ING-owned broad- and narrow-band filters used at the INT, WHT and JKT, by ING serial number.
short_description: Isaac Newton Group (La Palma) filter database, by serial number

notes: The ING page: 'The ING owns a large collection of broad and narrow band filters'. Per-filter text files (catserver.ing.iac.es/filter/filtercurve.php?format=txt&filter=N) no longer answer (HTTP 500 at astro.ing.iac.es); Internet Archive snapshots (2010-2011) were used. Each file records the filter name, system, passband, FWHM, cosmetics and scan date. SVO lists these as energy counters; here DetectorType=photon is assumed (CCD imaging). DetectorType of 126, 107 set to photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: ING's filter database gives this curve as 'ING Filter Throughput Data' of the filter alone, in percent, scanned on 2005-03-02 (catserver.ing.iac.es/filter/filtercurve.php, archived 2010; https://astro.ing.iac.es/filter/). The AAO Master Filter Catalog lists the same TAURUS filters (AAO #62 'WHT Filter f126', #63 'WHT Filter f107') with the same data. They are TAURUS filters (ING passbands 'TAURUS 5220/380' and 'TAURUS 5000/350'), for the TAURUS-2 focal reducer at the WHT and AAT, read by CCDs (Bland-Hawthorn & Jones 1998, PASA 15, 44). A filter-only transmission used with a CCD counts photons. SVO's DetectorType is not used. DetectorType of 198, 199, 200, 201 set to photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: ING's filter database gives this curve as 'ING Filter Throughput Data' of the filter alone, in percent, scanned on 2005-03-02 (catserver.ing.iac.es/filter/filtercurve.php, archived 2010; https://astro.ing.iac.es/filter/), for the INT Wide Field Camera, which 'consists of 4 thinned EEV42 2kx4k CCDs' (https://www.ing.iac.es/astronomy/instruments/wfc/). A filter-only transmission used with a CCD counts photons. SVO's DetectorType is not used.
